v0.4.0.description:
This apworld is still WIP/experimental, and it's not recommended to bring it to any public syncs/asyncs yet. Things should be stable, but a lot of things are untested, and things like logic or cutscenes played out of order might break until properly tested or proven otherwise, so please don't risk ruining the experience of public AP lobbies for others.

### Features
- Updated for AP 0.6.8
- Room logic for every single room in the game (ground items, how to traverse rooms, shops)
- Final Boss goal, as an actual goal instead of just collecting X artifacts
- Aria is now present in all of the Golden Settlement town maps, and lets you swap between day and night
- New yaml options:
  - Map Shuffle (a new Entrance Randomizer mode)
  - Artifact Shuffle
  - Shuffle Hidden Items
  - Shuffle Dig Spots
  - Shuffle Termacade
  - Minigame Prizes
  - DeathLink (also in the yaml now)
  - Start Inventory from Pool

### Logic
- Logic begins at the spawn; a tight start gets a forced early item
- Door shuffle retries when it fails, solving entrance rando failures

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed a lot of softlocks and crashes when doing story-related cutscenes out of order
- Removed a lot of unintended blockers stopping you from going to and from areas related to cutscenes and followers
- Opened up some entrances that could get you stuck when using entrance rando, for example the big wasp door between the Far Grasslands and the desert is always open now



**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Tsukino-uwu/Bug-Fables-Archipelago/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0
